design_rules: Use the registered probe wrapper exactly and change only the registered information-status state within each pair.
Downstream prompts are standalone decisions with one specified binary check. Use new domains and entities, no copied evidence, no unknown probability, and exactly one response contract.
Do not ask the model to label the information state or append a probe continuation sentence.

probe_train.instructions: Generate complete matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Keep evidence and wording identical within a pair except the registered information-status clause inside Scenario; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_validation.instructions: Generate new matched validation probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Change only the registered information-status clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_heldout.instructions: Generate held-out matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper and new domains. Change only the registered information-status clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

behavior_eval.instructions: Generate standalone single-check budget items with assigned metadata. Use exactly one binary check and one two-integer response contract; do not include an ambiguity label.

steering_eval.instructions: Generate a distinct standalone single-check budget pool with the same metadata schedule. Use exactly one binary check and one response contract.

calibration.instructions: Generate neutral standalone single-check budget items for calibration. Use exactly one binary check and one response contract.
